simple.meaning: אִשָּׁה (ʼishshâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a woman.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 781 times across Genesis, beginning at Genesis 2:22. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אִשָּׁה (H802).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אִשָּׁה (ʼishshâh) / H802 is traced through Genesis 2:22, Genesis 2:23, Genesis 2:24, Genesis 2:25 as a generated source-based concept entry.
